content:
anya: Kickoff: Maker Week quickstart seed plan. Goal: 2 tutorials, 1 refapp, webinar + micro-bench. Draft timeline below. Thoughts?

mike: Love it. Bench narrative — want one 'cost vs latency' bench using a simple blog example. Can we get data from runtime team?

jamal: @mike I can pull perf numbers from eng-runtime, but need exact model/config. Which model do we propose?

anya: Start with rw-7b-q4 (quantized), compare hosted vs dedicated. @jamal make it a developer POV not an ops deep-dive.

sophia: Webinar: target devs + platform folks. Suggested date: May 9 or May 16. 30-45 min + live Q&A. Anyone conflicts? :calendar:

mike: Prefer May 16. Gives time for data + slides. +1 on dev POV.

jamal: I'll fetch logs and run bench this week. ETA Wed EOD.

anya: Draft copy for launch post — quick snippet: 'Maker Week: ship LLM features faster with Redwood — tutorial + refapp + live bench' I'll paste full draft after jamal's numbers.

mike: For inbound routing, we should: a) webinar landing page b) UTM tags c) auto-tags in HubSpot with campaign=makerweek. @sophia can you confirm HubSpot flow?

sophia: Yes — will create 'makerweek' campaign, set up webhooks to mark MQL when webinar completes. Also add field 'workload-type' to capture 'tutorial|refapp|bench'.

jamal: Bench snippet for post (raw):
```
model=rw-7b-q4
seq=1024
batch=16
latency=45ms
tokens/s=2200
```
Numbers preliminary.

anya: :thumbsup: Good start. Mike can you draft the benchmark narrative (developer angle) using those numbers? Aim for 2 short charts: latency vs cost, throughput vs config.

mike: Yep, will draft. Also thinking of a short 'how we measured' blurb so readers trust the numbers.

nora: Quick ask — need hero screenshot from refapp. Who's building refapp? @anya?

anya: Refapp repo is 'maker-quickstart' — devs are me + jamal. I'll push a demo gif tomorrow.

sam-marketing-bot: Reminder: editorial calendar has a slot May 18 for long-form post. If we want that slot, finalize assets by May 11.

sophia: Noted. I'll block integrator to wire HubSpot by May 12.

mike: Also: social snippets — 2 tweets, 1 LinkedIn post, 1 short demo clip. I'll draft and share by Thu.

anya: Great. Action items: jamal: bench numbers Wed EOD; mike: benchmark narrative + socials Thu; sophia: HubSpot campaign by May 12; anya: refapp gif by Tue. Check-in Friday.

jamal: ack. Posting the raw CSV link in #eng later.
